title: Screen: TICKETS as Sections, and the status row's counts
description:
Per the map ticket 'Prototype: the screen updates' (harness-0sx.4), layout B 'Sections'. Prototype: branch prototype/screen-updates, src/shell/draw/prototype_screen.rs (cargo run -- __prototype-screen, Left/Right to variant B, Ctrl-T idle or live). Build it into src/shell/draw.rs; the prototype is throwaway, lift what fits.

TICKETS, no box. Each listed Epic is one rule line '━━ ▾ <id>  <title> ━━━… <detail>  <WORD>': id and title bold in the Epic's color, the ━ fill in that color dimmed toward BORDER, detail muted, WORD bold in its own color, padded to 11. Epic colors by place on the tree, cycling PURPLE, CYAN, ORANGE, PINK, BLUE, GREEN (hashing the id was tried and rejected). Its Tickets hang under it on '   ├─ ' / '   └─ ' in the dimmed Epic color: indicator, '<suffix> <title>' cut with …, the stage right-aligned in 16, the label in 11. Tickets keep their per-suffix colors (ticket_color).

Idle: every open Epic is listed. Detail spells out the nonzero counts, '3 closed · 1 in progress · 6 open'; WORD is RESUMABLE (purple, the saved run's Epic), ALL CLOSED (green, every Ticket closed: the Epic folds to its rule with ▸ and detail 'all 14 closed'), IN PROGRESS (a Ticket closed or in progress) or NOT STARTED (muted). Idle Ticket rows: ● IN PROGRESS, ✓ CLOSED. Live: only the Epics with a Ticket in the run; detail '2/11 merged', WORD RUNNING. Live Ticket rows: ● WORKING (the Ticket's color, pulsing), ◆ NEEDS YOU orange (a Question waiting or a trust wait: today's Screen::blocked), ◇ WAITING muted with stage 'waits on PR #31', ○ TO MERGE blue with 'PR #31', ✓ MERGED green with 'PR #29 merged', ◌ PARKED muted, · queued with no label.

Waiting on a merge is state, not an Event line: a run's open Ticket with a bd blocks dependency (BdIssue.dependencies) on a Ticket whose PR is open (pr-open). Ticket 3's MERGE TO UNBLOCK box reuses it.

Status row, live: '| RUNNING  ● N working  ◆ N needs you  ◇ N waiting on a merge  ○ N to merge  ◌ N parked  ✓ N merged', two spaces apart, each in its label's color; parked only when nonzero, and before merged. When the row is wider than the screen the glyphs drop, then the end is cut (merged, which the Overall bar also carries). An open PR no longer counts as complete. The idle row is unchanged. PgUp/PgDn scroll TICKETS, only when it overflows; Up/Down stay on TICKETS until Ticket 3 gives them to RECENT.

The reasoning behind each decision is on the map's closed tickets: bd show harness-0sx.<n> --json --include-comments. Research notes and prototypes live on local branches: git show research/<name>:docs/research/<file>.md, git show prototype/<name>:<path>. Vocabulary: CONTEXT.md. Decisions: docs/adr/. Rust; crates limited to serde, serde_json, regex, chrono, crossterm, ratatui and ureq, anything else needs a ticket.
acceptance_criteria: TestBackend renders, idle and live, over a fake bd list: one rule line per Epic in its color by place; the four idle WORDs and the ALL CLOSED fold; each live label with its stage text; a live run lists only its Epics. Status row: a count per label, parked hidden at zero, glyphs dropped then the end cut on a narrow screen; an open PR counts as to merge. A Ticket blocked by an open Ticket whose PR is open reads WAITING 'waits on PR #N'.
